candidate_relations.reason: The germline SUFU splice-site mutation with tumor-specific loss of the trans allele supports a hereditary SUFU tumor syndrome, but the benchmark specifically requires MHIBCC, defined here by numerous hereditary infundibulocystic basal cell carcinomas. The candidate does not preserve that required histopathologic subtype and syndrome designation.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Broader SUFU-associated nevoid basal cell carcinoma syndrome label that omits the specific multiple hereditary infundibulocystic BCC phenotype.
